### PUBPOL 2030: Population and Demography
Teaching Assistant for Sharon Sassler · Spring 2024

An introduction to economic demography for first- and second-year undergraduates. I oversaw a team of six undergraduate teaching assistants, coordinating and supervising their weekly discussion sections, and guest lectured on the gender wage gap.

<span class="pill-tag">Outstanding Teaching Assistant Award, Brooks School</span>

### PADM 5310: Applied Multivariate Statistics in Public Affairs
Teaching Assistant for Doug Miller · Fall 2023

An introduction to statistics and causal inference methods for MPA students. I led weekly lab sections training students in Stata, guiding them from data management through the estimation and interpretation of applied empirical analysis.

### ECON 375: Introduction to Econometrics
Teaching Assistant for Carolina Castilla · Fall 2021 & Spring 2022

An introduction to econometric methods for junior and senior undergraduates. I oversaw and led weekly lab sections covering core econometric methods, and advised students on the independent empirical research projects they completed at the end of each term.
